# Instrument Serif

Instrument Serif Regular, Latin subset, normal style, weight 400. Retain the
complete SIL Open Font License in `OFL.txt`. Do not synthesize a bold face.

- Project: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/instrumentserif
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/instrumentserif/OFL.txt
- Exact WOFF2: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/instrumentserif/v5/jizBRFtNs2ka5fXjeivQ4LroWlx-6zUTjnTLgNs.woff2
- Retrieved: 2026-09-11. No binary transformation.
- WOFF2 SHA-256: `60c06664b5a95c7de6cc3e00d1f9034d78bd1e40b564016b241674449a067d4d`
- OFL SHA-256: `129ed7618959716959f2941fdd5b49e0ad6e6c1d78726761786a00253d865521`

The optional editorial marketing preset uses this display face. Nebula Sans
remains the package's default proportional family and the minimal preset face.
